name: Kitsune
source:
One of the kitsune who serve Inari.

Their strength is considered impressive even among the Ayakashi. Without the aid of the Divine Swords, it's impossible to so much as injure them.

During the incident that took place a century ago, one of them took the the life of Utano, the previous wielder of Len's sword. They inflicted severe casualties on the Capital Branch.

[spoiler]Divine Sword wielders have hunted these Ayakashi to near extinction. Excluding Inari, only two one-tailed kitsune remain.[/spoiler]

[Based on [url=https://k-yomiji.sakura.ne.jp/kyouhime/#a_chara9]two[/url] separate [url=https://k-yomiji.sakura.ne.jp/kyouhime2/#a_chara9]descriptions[/url] provided by the author.]
